Class MenuChrome

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.inject.MenuChrome
@Internal public final class MenuChrome extends Object
Library-owned registry of vanilla-menu-chrome extents — the pixel amounts each AbstractContainerScreen subclass draws outside its declared imageWidth × imageHeight frame. The M5 region system consults this registry when resolving MenuContext region origins so panels anchor to the effective visible edge of the screen, not the declared frame edge.

See menukit/Design Docs/Phase 12.5/M7_CHROME_AWARE_REGIONS.md for the design rationale and Principle 9 tie-in.

Resolution — exact-class only

of(AbstractContainerScreen) looks up by screen.getClass() — no inheritance walk. Rationale: vanilla subclass relationships don't map to chrome relationships (creative's tabs live on CreativeModeInventoryScreen; its parents don't draw tabs). Exact- class-only is predictable and avoids the "register on a base class, accidentally cover every screen in existence" foot-gun. Modded consumers register for their own concrete classes.

Transition semantics

Chrome extents are recomputed per frame via MenuChrome.ChromeProvider. Dynamic providers read live screen state (recipe book open/closed); static providers ignore the screen parameter and return a constant. When a screen's chrome changes mid-session (recipe book toggle), there may be a one-frame visual transition as the provider picks up the new state. In practice imperceptible; acceptable for current cases.

  • Method Details

    • register

      public static <T extends net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen<?>> void register(Class<T> screenClass, MenuChrome.ChromeProvider provider)
      Registers a chrome provider for a screen class. First registration of a class wins; subsequent calls with the same class are no-ops with a warning log (same pattern as MKSlotState.register).

      Called at mod init — library-shipped providers register during MKClient.onInitializeClient; modded consumers register from their own ClientModInitializer.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the screen type
      Parameters:
      screenClass - the concrete screen class
      provider - the provider

    • of

      public static MenuChrome.ChromeExtents of(net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen<?> screen)
      Returns the chrome extents for the given screen instance. Exact-class match on screen.getClass(); returns MenuChrome.ChromeExtents.NONE for screens without a registered provider.

      Called per-frame from RegionRegistry.resolveMenuOrigin as part of origin computation. Must be cheap.
